source.author: ov
source.text: Vina dabant animos, et prima pocula pugna missa volant fragilesque cadi curvique lebetes, res epulis quondam, tum bello et caedibus aptae.
source.text_original: Vina dabant animos, et prima pocula pugna / missa volant fragilesque cadi curvique lebetes, / res epulis quondam, tum bello et caedibus aptae.
source.text_english: Wine gave courage, and the first drinking cups fly off as missiles in the fight; fragile jars and bent cauldrons, once things for feasts, are now suited to war and slaughter.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_original: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum / poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_english: craters and tables and altars of the gods fly about, and cups, a notable workmanship of the ancients.
